name: GapOS
install: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.0 --activate && CI=true pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Next.js PWA shell + HTTP API on :3000. Runs against in-memory repositories and deterministic fake providers (no database or API keys needed). Set GAPOS_DATABASE_URL to use Postgres.

terminals.name: worker
terminals.description: Durable generation worker (compile loop). Runs in fake/in-memory mode by default; set GAPOS_DATABASE_URL and GAPOS_STORAGE for durable Postgres + S3-backed runs.
